steps.vmafTargetSearch: Finding the quality for the VMAF target…

errors.sourceGoneLikelyConverted: Source file no longer exists — it was most likely already converted (the original is replaced by the HEVC output). Rescan the library to refresh this entry.
errors.audioCleanupOnDisc: Audio/sub cleanup can't run on a disc image (ISO/VIDEO_TS/BDMV) — a disc must be fully converted, not stream-copied. Rescan and queue a conversion for this title to apply the cleanup.
errors.customFlagsRejected: Custom ffmpeg flags rejected at '{{token}}'; fix them in Settings → System
errors.notEnoughDiskSpace: Not enough free disk space: need {{need}} bytes, have {{free}} bytes free
errors.outputExists: A file named {{name}} already exists; not replacing it
errors.outputMissing: Output file missing or empty after conversion.
errors.outputTruncated: Output is shorter than the source ({{output}}s of {{source}}s): the file is probably damaged, or reading it was interrupted. Original kept. Retry once; if it's short again, request a replacement.
errors.sourceReadFailed: The source couldn't be read to the end ({{error}}). Original kept; retry the job.
errors.outputUnverifiable: Couldn't read the output's length to check it's complete. Original kept; retry the job.
errors.dolbyVisionSkipped: Dolby Vision is kept for profiles 7 and 8 encoded to HEVC at the same size, with dovi_tool and mkvmerge installed; this file isn't. Nothing was converted.
errors.hdrNeeds10Bit: HDR video needs a 10-bit encoder; {{encoder}} encodes 8-bit here. Use NVENC, libx265 or VideoToolbox. Nothing was converted.

dolbyVisionKept.disc: The video was kept as it is: Dolby Vision on a disc isn't re-encoded.
dolbyVisionKept.profile: The video was kept as it is: Dolby Vision profile {{profile}} isn't re-encoded (only profiles 7 and 8 keep their Dolby Vision).
dolbyVisionKept.tools: The video was kept as it is: keeping Dolby Vision needs dovi_tool and mkvmerge, which aren't installed.
dolbyVisionKept.encoder: The video was kept as it is: Dolby Vision is kept with NVENC, libx265 or VideoToolbox, not {{encoder}}.
dolbyVisionKept.codec: The video was kept as it is: Dolby Vision is kept when converting to HEVC, not {{codec}}.
dolbyVisionKept.resize: The video was kept as it is: Dolby Vision is kept only at the same resolution, and this job resizes it to {{resolution}}.
dolbyVisionKept.ffmpeg: The video was kept as it is: dropping Dolby Vision needs ffmpeg 7.1 or later, and it can't be kept for this job.

errors.hdrKept8Bit: The video was kept as it is: HDR video needs a 10-bit encoder; {{encoder}} encodes 8-bit here. Use NVENC, libx265 or VideoToolbox.
errors.dolbyVisionNotDropped: Dolby Vision was to be dropped, but the new file still carries it. Original kept.
errors.encodeLarger: The converted file was {{pct}}% larger than the original, so the original was kept.
errors.hdrLost: The {{format}} source lost its HDR in the encode. Original kept.
errors.remuxOutputMissing: Output file missing or empty after remux.
errors.sourceDamaged: The source file looks damaged: ffmpeg found broken frames it couldn't decode. It's marked corrupt in the Scanner; request a replacement from Sonarr or Radarr.
errors.originalLikelyCorrupt: Original file likely corrupt — conversion produced an unusably-small output ({{outputMb}} MB from {{originalGb}} GB source). ffmpeg hit data corruption ffprobe doesn't catch upfront. It's marked corrupt in the Scanner; original kept. Request a replacement from Sonarr or Radarr.
errors.tracksChanged: The file's tracks changed since it was scanned; rescan it and queue the cleanup again
errors.vmafRejected: VMAF {{score}} is below the configured minimum of {{min}} — encode rejected, original kept.
errors.workerEncoderUnsupported: Worker cannot run encoder '{{encoder}}' and translation is disabled
errors.wouldRemoveAllAudio: Refusing to remove every audio track — the file would have no sound. Check the file's audio tracks in the Scanner and queue it again.
errors.reviewOriginalChanged: The original changed or went away since it was reviewed; the converted file was discarded
errors.reviewOutputMissing: The converted file waiting for review is gone
errors.dolbyVisionLost: Couldn't keep Dolby Vision: {{reason}}. Original kept.

monitor.nvencNoEncoder: ffmpeg build has no hevc_nvenc encoder
monitor.capabilitiesForced: capabilities forced via CAPABILITIES env var
